newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin OK after successful surgery - source.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin OK after successful surgery - source.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin was "OK" after his open heart surgery which went well, a source at Moscow's Cardiology Research Centre said by telephone on Tuesday.
Asked about the course of the operation, the source said: "Everything was fine, great." Asked about Yeltsin's condition after the bypass surgery, the source answered: "He is OK".
